description.value: Regional bus systems throughout BC outside Metro Vancouver. Most buses are equipped with exterior front-mounted 2-bike racks; bikes ride unboxed. No bike fee. Trailers not permitted. E-bike policy varies by system — check with your local system before travelling. Regional systems include: Squamish and Whistler (WAVE), Chilliwack, Kelowna Regional, Vernon Regional, Kamloops, Cranbrook/East Kootenay, Nelson, South Okanagan (Penticton), Cowichan Valley, Victoria Regional, and Pacific Rim (Tofino/Ucluelet). Bike racks on community buses can only be used during daylight hours, as bikes block the headlights; all other BC Transit buses have no time-of-day restrictions.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Free front-mounted bike racks on all buses; lithium e-bikes under 25 kg with battery removed

E-bikes OK.detail: under 25 kg, lithium battery removed and carried with you
